visualAssessment.F02: No incremental regression observed. Supplemental settings shell validation also passes. This does not waive the separate current-navigation text-contrast finding. visualAssessment.modalityCorrection: Capture04 settings PNGs scroll to the workspace (y504 wide, y496 medium, y1341 narrow), leaving the corrected context off-frame. visualAssessment.darkCurrentNavigation: Blocking drift: the enabled current Research Intent label is visibly dark blue against dark navy in supplemental dark1440/dark1280. Candidate .sidebar button[aria-current] resolves #2d58b3 foreground on #0d2241 background. Independently calculated contrast is 2.388648267142677:1, below the 4.5:1 normal-text requirement (and even 3:1). The approved reference explicitly uses light current-navigation text in dark theme. This inherited defect is inside the current visual/accessibility acceptance surface, not authority for a new design. The visible 12px current-step number also fails normal-text contrast: #071629 on #3d70dc calculates 3.936219553124029:1. Both defects are consolidated in visual03-F01.

findings.title: Enabled current navigation label and step marker fail dark-theme contrast
criteria: W1.A08.T02 criterion 3: light/dark geometry and effective states
W1.A08.T02 criterion 4: independent visual disposition cannot waive accessibility or interaction contracts
Approved STYLE_GUIDE section 9: WCAG 2.2 AA; section 6: distinguish current workflow state

evidence.calculation: Linearize each sRGB channel c with c/12.92 for c<=0.04045, otherwise ((c+0.055)/1.055)^2.4; luminance=0.2126R+0.7152G+0.0722B; ratio=(max(L1,L2)+0.05)/(min(L1,L2)+0.05). Foreground luminance0.10792008797162483, background0.016112742568218416.
evidence.modality: Colors are derived from exact authenticated candidate CSS/token cascade and corroborated by actual viewed pixels; no new DOM/computed-color measurement or browser run was performed for this finding.
evidence.disabledExemption: Source-bound ApplicationRuntime passes the same disabled expression to sidebar WorkflowNavigation and main WorkflowContextBar. Captured Return is enabled, Research Intent is an implemented current stage, and the source adds disabled only for that global expression or an unimplemented stage. Thus this current label is not exempt disabled text; this conclusion is source/state inference, not a new captured sidebar-disabled field.
evidence.reference: Bound design/ui-reference/assets/app.css dark .workflow-nav-step.current explicitly uses light #b9d1ff foreground; the product does not inherit that reference-only rule. Exact reference color duplication is not required, but sufficient contrast within the approved styling contract is.
evidence.coverageGap: The current semantic samples cover workspace/context buttons, while sidebar samples cover shell rectangles. Their PASS does not establish contrast of enabled current-navigation text.

currentStepMarker.qualification: The visible ordered step number is text in an enabled control. aria-hidden avoids redundant speech and is not a visual contrast exemption.

reproduction: Inspect the immutable dark1440 or dark1280 supplemental PNG: Research Intent is the current sidebar step and its title is low-contrast dark blue.
Read ddba5f5f app.css current page/step selector and dark token values from design/ui-reference/assets/tokens.css; apply the stated luminance formula.
Follow the unchanged current/disabled conditions in WorkflowNavigation.tsx and shared disabled prop in ApplicationRuntime.tsx; compare the captured enabled Return state.
findings.requiredRemediation: Restore theme-aware current page/step text and current-step marker contrast using the existing approved semantic palette or established approved styling pattern, without changing navigation authority, labels, callbacks or tokens. Add focused actual-rendered contrast regressions for the direct text nodes of enabled current step/page controls, including label, marker and metadata, in both themes; retain these negative results and supply bounded fresh source-bound dark-current-navigation visual proof. Do not waive failures as inherited, decorative or disabled, or relabel passing geometry as contrast proof.
findings.scopeQualification: This is inherited production drift surfaced by current acceptance evidence, not a claim that the workflow Button correction introduced it. No unrelated redesign or full product audit is requested.
